notes: Hotfix: updates now install themselves even when antivirus blocks helper scripts (fixes the 'unable to start correctly (0xc0000142)' error during update - if updating still fails on the old version, re-download the ZIP from your Payhip link once). Voice playback got backup routes for systems where the engineer went silent after the radio beep (including Windows N editions), and the app now reports the exact cause to us so 'no sound' problems can finally be diagnosed and fixed.
